use_cases.title: Happy-path order with pricing
use_cases.prompt: I need 12 squares of Timberline HDZ Charcoal for Sunshine Roofing Supply, deliver to Tampa next Tuesday.
use_cases.expects: Order ready for review with unit price, add-on lines and total; no warnings.

use_cases.title: Bulk order -- multiple lines
use_cases.prompt: Magic City Distributors needs 30 squares HDZ Weathered Wood, 20 squares HDZ Barkwood, 12 squares UHDZ Charcoal and 10 rolls Tiger Paw, job-site delivery in Miami by Sept 24.
use_cases.expects: Four priced lines, volume + distributor discounts, suggested add-ons the rep can tick on.

use_cases.title: Credit review -- order exceeds available credit
use_cases.prompt: Bayline Distributors needs 40 squares of Timberline HDZ Barkwood to Miami by Sept 24.
use_cases.expects: Blocked -- account under credit review and the order total exceeds available credit.

use_cases.title: Customer doesn't know squares (roof estimate)
use_cases.prompt: Peachtree Contractors has a two-storey house, about 4,000 sq ft, 6/12 pitch, wants Timberline HDZ Slate. How much should they order?
use_cases.expects: Assistant estimates the roof area, proposes squares and asks the rep to confirm before building the order.

use_cases.title: Vague request -- needs clarification
use_cases.prompt: Lone Star wants some Timberline for a job in Dallas.
use_cases.expects: Assistant asks for colour, quantity and unit instead of guessing.

use_cases.title: Credit hold + urgent delivery
use_cases.prompt: Lauderdale Roofing Co needs 60 squares of Timberline HDZ Slate in Fort Lauderdale tomorrow.
use_cases.expects: Blocked -- account on credit hold; routed to credit, no promise on delivery.

use_cases.title: Duplicate order check
use_cases.prompt: Reorder 60 squares of Timberline UHDZ Charcoal for Lone Star Distribution to Dallas, same as ORD-77009.
use_cases.expects: Duplicate warning against ORD-77009; rep must acknowledge before confirming.

use_cases.title: Seasonal + volume discounts
use_cases.prompt: Quote 65 squares of Timberline HDZ Charcoal for Sunshine Roofing Supply with the full WindProven add-on set, Tampa, Oct 1.
use_cases.expects: Fall promo 4% + volume 5% on shingles, Complete System 5% on add-ons, shown as separate discount lines.

use_cases.title: Ambiguous customer name
use_cases.prompt: Tampa Contractor needs 20 squares of HDZ Charcoal.
use_cases.expects: Two accounts match -- assistant asks which one.

use_cases.title: WindProven requirements (auto-answer)
use_cases.prompt: What do I need on a Timberline HDZ order in Naples for the WindProven warranty, and is HDZ approved for Florida?
use_cases.expects: High-confidence grounded answer citing DOC-102 and DOC-101; no human review.

use_cases.title: HVHZ nailing pattern (escalate)
use_cases.prompt: Tell me exactly how many nails and the fastener spacing for an HDZ roof at 1120 Brickell Bay Dr, Miami-Dade.
use_cases.expects: Expert escalation to Technical Services -- no design-specific instructions.

use_cases.title: Leak report (urgent)
use_cases.prompt: A customer's HDZ roof from May is leaking after Tuesday's storm, water on the ceiling. What now?

use_cases.title: No approved source
use_cases.prompt: Exactly how many years does the StainGuard algae coverage last and what percentage is covered?
use_cases.expects: Answer withheld -- label exists but no terms in an approved source.

use_cases.title: Low-confidence -> human review
use_cases.prompt: Is HDZ okay for coastal Florida if we mix in another manufacturer's ridge cap?
use_cases.expects: Confidence below 95 (county missing, mixed-manufacturer question) -> queued for human review.

use_cases.title: Certified contractors near a ZIP
use_cases.prompt: Find GAF-certified roofers near 30061, ideally Master Elite.
use_cases.expects: Contractor cards with certification tier, rating, distance and phone.

use_cases.title: Contractors for a customer's city
use_cases.prompt: Which certified contractors could install a UHDZ roof for Queen City Builders' homeowner in Charlotte?
use_cases.expects: Contractors near 28202 with the warranties each tier can offer.

use_cases.title: Product comparison
use_cases.prompt: What's the difference between Timberline HDZ and UHDZ, and what does each cost per square?
use_cases.expects: Grounded comparison with prices from the catalogue and product cards.
